name: A Failure to Launch
summary: In a world where, after decades of struggle, the futanari are only just getting the social and cultural recognition they have wanted, you follow Alex, a 21 year old physical embodiment of sloth. After failing to secure a job (more like not even bothering with it), and spending the better part of a year doing nothing at all, he is finally kicked out of his home by his dad. While trying to get his life in order, he will come across many ladies, some with a "little extra", and mysterious pasts. Help him navigate this cruel world, overcome societal stigmas, secure a job, and find relationships.
